title: MobPouch
description: MobPouch lets you capture any entity in the world mobs, animals, even vehicles and carry them around in a single item. Simply right-click to catch, sneak + right-click to release.
body:
## MobPouch
Capture a mob, store it in a pouch, and release it later with full entity data preserved.

- Right-click a mob to capture
- Sneak + right-click to release
- One mob per pouch (non-stackable item)
- Fully configurable recipe, filters, sounds, and effects
- Includes built-in resource pack support
